name: @arena/expert-performance-service
description: Arena expert-performance reference service (Work Order C005; issue #112). In-process read/projection service over @arena/expert-performance: append-only evidence ingestion resolved through the injected PUBLIC dep source ports (the C004 calibration-verdict source, the A007 qualification + match-history source, the A019 skill-extraction source, the A020 learning-attribution source) — evidence NEVER enters the profile unless the owning port resolves its provenance digest (fabricated/tampered provenance fails closed), and the same source digest can never be counted twice in a dimension (evidence-replay inflation defense). Serves TWO lenses over the SAME canonical dimensional profile (roles-and-contexts same-object/different-lens rule): the routing input for the C002 demonstrated-performance / historical-task-fit seam, and the expert-facing capability-history projection — both deterministic given injected times (no hidden clocks), both staleness-aware under the explicit versioned freshness policy. Commands carry REQUIRED idempotency keys (lock rule 17); cross-tenant record reads fail closed; tampered store entries fail closed with digest re-verification; a global/overall score request has no code path at all (the no-single-global-score law).
